Run Simulation with Chunked Execution (Near Real-time Updates)

run_simulation_chunked.Rd

Processes walkers in batches, updating the grid between batches. Walkers in subsequent batches see black pixels created by earlier batches. Uses crew for parallel execution within each batch.

Usage

run_simulation_chunked(
  grid,
  walkers,
  n_workers,
  neighborhood,
  boundary,
  max_steps,
  start_time,
  validate_strict,
  validate_percent,
  log_interval,
  batch_size = 10
)

Arguments

grid

Numeric matrix. Initialized grid.

walkers

List. Created walker objects.

n_workers

Integer. Number of crew workers.

neighborhood

Character. "4-hood" or "8-hood".

boundary

Character. "terminate" or "wrap".

max_steps

Integer. Maximum steps limit.

start_time

POSIXct. Simulation start time.

validate_strict

Logical. Strict validation mode.

validate_percent

Numeric. Validation frequency.

batch_size

Integer. Number of walkers per batch (default 10).

Value

List with grid, walkers, and statistics
